quests.title: Race Day
quests.summary: Get a racing sloop ready for Anguilla Day: a sail, a plank, a sloopling for luck, and a rival to beat.

steps.text: Collect a sail from the Sailmaker near the boats.
Borrow a plank from the Carpenter by the harbour.
Catch a sloopling and show the Boat Builder.
Beat Rival Skipper Kincaid in Road Bay, then tell the Boat Builder.

quests.reward: A Race Pennant (a charm: tide moves hurt less).
